ei.title: Analysis — 인공 신경망의 지도 학습(오류 역전파) 메커니즘과 학습의 느림
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본2

fullPassage: Most artificial neural networks used in present-day artificial intelligence, despite their millions of inputs, outputs, and adjustable parameters, operate just like our proverbial hunter: they observe their errors and use them to adjust their internal state in the direction that they feel is best able to reduce the errors. In many cases, such learning is tightly guided. We tell the network exactly which response it should have activated at the output ("it is a 1, not a 7"), and we know precisely in which direction to adjust the parameters if they lead to an error (a mathematical calculation makes it possible to know exactly which connections to modify when the network activates the output "7" too often in response to an image of the number 1). In machine learning parlance, this situation is known as "supervised learning" (because someone, who can be likened to a supervisor, knows the correct answer that the system must give) and "error backpropagation" (because error signals are sent back into the network in order to modify its parameters). The procedure is simple: I try an answer, I am told what I should have answered, I measure my error, and I adjust my parameters to reduce it. At each step, I make only a small correction in the right direction. That's why such computer-based learning can be incredibly slow: learning a complex activity, like playing Tetris, requires applying this recipe thousands, millions, even billions of times. In a space that includes a multitude of adjustable parameters, it can take a long time to discover the optimal setting for every nut and bolt.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) observe 관찰하다 (B) modify 수정하다 (C) slow 느린
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore - modify - slow: (A) 신경망은 오류를 무시(ignore)가 아니라 관찰(observe)함
❌ ② observe - preserve - fast: (B) 파라미터를 보존(preserve)이 아니라 수정(modify)함, (C) 학습은 빠른(fast)이 아니라 느림
✅ ③ observe - modify - slow: 원문 그대로 — 오류를 관찰하고, 파라미터를 수정하며, 학습이 느림 ← 정답
❌ ④ ignore - preserve - fast: 세 개 모두 반의어로 교체된 오답
det.tip: observe=관찰하다(ant: ignore), modify=수정하다(ant: preserve), slow=느린(ant: fast)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) reduce 줄이다 (B) correct 올바른 (C) optimal 최적의
det.analysis:
✅ ① reduce - correct - optimal: 원문 그대로 — 오류를 줄이고, 올바른 답을 알며, 최적의 설정을 찾음 ← 정답
❌ ② increase - correct - worst: (A) 오류를 늘리는(increase) 게 아니라 줄임, (C) 최악(worst)이 아니라 최적
❌ ③ reduce - wrong - optimal: (B) 감독자는 틀린(wrong) 답이 아니라 올바른(correct) 답을 앎
❌ ④ increase - wrong - worst: 세 개 모두 반의어 교체
det.tip: reduce=줄이다(ant: increase), correct=올바른(ant: wrong), optimal=최적의(ant: worst)

④ slow(느린): 컴퓨터 기반 학습이 느릴 수 있음 — 적절

questions.passage: Most artificial neural networks used in present-day artificial intelligence, despite their millions of inputs, outputs, and adjustable parameters, operate just like our proverbial hunter: they observe their errors and use them to adjust their internal state in the direction that they feel is best able to reduce the errors. In many cases, such learning is tightly guided. We tell the network exactly which response it should have activated at the output ("it is a 1, not a 7"), and we know <u>precisely</u> in which direction to adjust the parameters if they lead to an error (a mathematical calculation makes it possible to know exactly which connections to modify when the network activates the output "7" too often in response to an image of the number 1). In machine learning parlance, this situation is known as "supervised learning" (because someone, who can be likened to a supervisor, knows the correct answer that the system must give) and "error backpropagation" (because error signals are sent back into the network in order to modify its parameters). The procedure is simple: I try an answer, I am told what I should have answered, I measure my error, and I adjust my parameters to reduce it. At each step, I make only a small correction in the right direction. That's why such computer-based learning can be incredibly slow: learning a complex activity, like playing Tetris, requires applying this recipe thousands, millions, even billions of times. In a space that includes a multitude of adjustable parameters, it can take a long time to discover the optimal setting for every nut and bolt.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 precisely와 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: precisely: 정확히, 꼭
det.analysis:
❌ ① roughly(대략): precisely의 반대
✅ ② exactly(정확히): precisely와 동의어 ← 정답
❌ ③ rarely(드물게): 빈도의 의미로 무관
❌ ④ slowly(느리게): 속도의 의미로 무관
det.tip: precisely=정확히(syn: exactly, accurately)

(A) The learning system keeps adjusting its internal <u>state</u> until the output errors become as small as possible.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 state의 문맥적 의미가 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: state: (A) 상태 (명사) (B) 진술하다/말하다 (동사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 상태 - (B) 상태: (B)는 'state her name'으로 목적어를 취하는 동사
❌ ② (A) 진술하다 - (B) 진술하다: (A)는 its internal state로 소유격의 수식을 받는 명사
✅ ③ (A) 상태 - (B) 진술하다: (A) internal state=내부 '상태'(명사), (B) state her name=이름을 '진술하다'(동사) ← 정답
❌ ④ (A) 진술하다 - (B) 상태: 품사가 뒤바뀜
det.tip: state: 명사=상태, 동사=진술하다/말하다. 소유격 뒤면 명사, 목적어를 취하면 동사

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to make small changes to something, especially in order to improve it or make it more suitable"

❌ ④ guide(안내하다): 방향을 이끄는 것으로 정의와 다름
det.tip: modify=수정하다. '조금씩 바꾸다(make small changes)'가 핵심 단서
